zh.before: 自己收集数据训练检测模型，再分别移植到手机、网页等各个平台。

roles.dev: 用它的手部关键点检测处理一张图片，并画出结果。

roles.qa: 关注光线、遮挡、低端机性能和不同摄像头的差异。
roles.algo: 位于推理层，提供可直接部署的预训练视觉模型。

en.what: Google's on-device ML toolkit with ready-made models for hand, face and pose tracking that run on mobile, web and desktop.
en.before: Collected data and trained detection models yourself, then ported them separately to each platform.

roles.dev: Run its hand landmark detection on an image and draw the results.
roles.pm: Makes gesture control, face effects and workout pose recognition cheap to build.
roles.qa: Test lighting, occlusion, low-end device performance and camera differences.
roles.algo: Inference layer: provides deployable pretrained vision models.
